cli.agents_picture.error.no_agent.note: CLI error when the agent argument matches no agent by name or id. {agent} is what the user typed.

cli.agents_picture.error.read_file.note: CLI error when the image path can't be read. {path} is a filesystem path, {error} an OS error string (English, untranslated).

cli.agents_picture.help.agent.note: argparse help for the positional agent argument.

cli.agents_picture.help.file.note: argparse help for the image path argument. Format names stay as-is.

cli.agents_picture.help.remove.note: argparse help for `lop agents picture remove <agent>`.

cli.agents_picture.help.set.note: argparse help for `lop agents picture set <agent> <file>`.

cli.agents_picture.help.show.note: argparse help for `lop agents picture show <agent>`; JSON is literal.

cli.agents_picture.remove.done.note: CLI success line after removing an agent's picture. {agent} is a name.

cli.agents_picture.remove.none.note: CLI line when the agent had no picture. {agent} is a name.

cli.agents_picture.set.done.note: CLI success line. {agent} is the agent's name, {mime} a MIME type like image/png (literal), {bytes} an integer byte count (already formatted digits).
